label: a size claim may rest on a Tailwind class name again, so the reviewer infers a rendered box and the gate is left with no verdict
old: echo "A claim about a control's size or tap target must quote a MEASUREMENT that is in the evidence: a walk.json lint reading (e.g. smallTapTargets), or a measured box the PR records. A Tailwind/CSS class name is NOT a measurement — a class is overridden by min-width/min-height rules and media queries, so it does not tell you what was rendered. If a class name is the only support for a size claim, write 'not measurable from the evidence' and do not score that axis below 3 for it."
